title: AI adoption in code reviews
context: At Witik, the 10-person delivery team (6 developers, 2 QA engineers, 1 product owner and me as Tech Lead Delivery) contributes to a B2B SaaS platform used by 20,000+ users and 100+ clients.
action: I introduced Claude Code for assisted reviews, structured prompts and automated quality checklists.
result: The AI workflows reduced the workload of selected recurring code review, impact analysis and technical documentation tasks by roughly 50%. This refers to workload for those activities, not the duration of each review.

title: Delivery management at Witik
context: The 10-person delivery team had to coordinate the technical roadmap, releases and business priorities for a platform with 100+ clients.
action: I managed the backlog and releases through Azure DevOps, coordinated business/product/QA/development, and tracked risks and 2,000+ tickets.
result: Delivery sustained roughly 2 production deployments per month on a platform serving 20,000+ users and 100+ clients. No comparable prior baseline is available.

title: Multi-client projects and SRM at Sofia Holding
context: Critical multi-client projects included a Supplier Management (SRM) platform to improve communication and supplier integration for OneTech.
action: I led architecture, task breakdown and estimation, scheduling, integration and regression test cycles, and delivery validation.
result: The documented deliverable is a Supplier Management / SRM platform designed to facilitate communication between OneTech and its suppliers and improve supplier integration.
